messages:
elena (AE): Hey team — HealthCo (healthcare SaaS) wants SOC 2 artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation before we spin up a dedicated staging env. They also asked for our KMS/HSM keyflow details. Who can own the evidence handoff and staging creds?

 david (SE): Quick q — is this going to be Hosted or Dedicated POC? That changes what we can share.

 elena (AE): Dedicated staging — customer asked for isolated GPUs + VPC peering. They may ask on-prem later but not yet.

 kai (Infra): VPC peering + dedicated pool is fine. We'll need customer AWS account IDs, VPC CIDRs, and the peering request. For staging creds we only issue timeboxed service accounts (no long-lived keys).

 nora (Security): For SOC2 we can share the Summary of Findings and the control mapping CSV. Full SOC2 report requires an NDA. For pen-test attestation we have a standard signed letter; legal may want to review wording.

 elena (AE): Legal asked to pre-review the pen-test wording. Can you drop the template here so they can look?

 nora (Security): Template: `https://internal.redwood.com/security/pen-test-template.pdf` — note the scope language covers hosted + dedicated environments. If HealthCo needs the scope limited to their tenant only, that requires either a targeted test or a scope carve-out.

 david (SE): If they want customer-managed keys: we support AWS KMS + CloudHSM in Private. We'll need an IAM role with `kms:Decrypt` permissions for the CMK and a key policy allowing the role.

 kai (Infra): Action items: 1) elena collect ARNs/CIDRs, 2) nora prepare signed pen-test attestation, 3) infra to prepare one-time staging creds and a VPC peering playbook. Draft playbook snippet below:
```
1. create peering connection from customer VPC to redwood-staging-vpc
2. update route tables to allow --/32 to peered routes
3. create short-lived service account (expires in 72h)
4. share one-time kubeconfig via 1Password transient secret
```

 elena (AE): Timeline? HealthCo wants POC started in ~2 weeks.

 nora (Security): I can have the signed attestation + control mapping uploaded by EOD tomorrow if legal has no redlines.

 david (SE): I'll prepare a network diagram + estimate for dedicated staging pricing (quick ballpark: reserved GPU delta + network egress estimate).

 elena (AE): Who signs the pen-test letter — Security or Legal?

 nora (Security): Security signs the operational attestation. Legal signs any contractual language. I'll loop in jenna-legal.

 jenna (Legal): Thanks — please @me with the exact pen-test filename and the customer's legal name. Also confirm whether an NDA is signed; I won't release full reports without it.

 audit-bot: Compliance package uploaded to `#/compliance/healthco-poc/` by nora: includes SOC2-summary.pdf and control-mapping.csv.

 elena (AE): Received — thanks :thumbsup: I'll collect the ARNs/CIDRs from HealthCo and drop them here by EOD.

 kai (Infra): Note: for staging creds we prefer one-time access via 1Password transient secrets rather than raw secrets in chat. Saves rotation work. :lock: 

 david (SE): Also: if they request a third-party pen-test certificate, we can provide the assessor contact and attestation of engagement, but not the third-party report without NDA.

 elena (AE): Perfect. I'll confirm NDA status and update the thread. Thanks all, looping customer ops for transparency (cc: healthco-ops).
